[quote=dhornaper;59806483][B]The Captain[/b]

The captain approaches the receiver with Colonel Jamshid's eyes boring into his back.

"President Koroush, this is Captain Ismail of air force base Dashte-e Shar."

"There is a military coup ocurring in the capital. You must prepare your men and take charge of the surrounding units of the air force and army to enter Shar and arrest General Fereydun and his co-conspirators, do you understand?"

Captain Ismail turns towards Colonel Jamshid who nods. "Yes sir."

"I will be enroute to your air base in approximately 40 minutes. Get this done overtime."

"Yes sir."

"Over and out."

Colonel Jamshid thinks for a moment before radioing General Fereydun.

"President Koroush's plane is enroute to the air base."

"Intercept him, detain him, and then bring him to the Army Headquarters."

"Yes sir."

Colonel Jamshid puts the radio away and orders Captain Ismail to intercept the President under the guise of ensuring his plane's safe passage to the air base. "If he gets suspicious and wants to land elsewhere, you force him to come with. If he deviates from his assigned flight path, you blow him out of the air, got it?"

Captain Ismail sighs and says "yes sir" before leaving with the colonel to get his men ready.

[B]The Interception[/b]

The fighter jets take off and cruise at altitude before radioing in. "This is Squadron Leader Tabari, we have been sent by Captain Ismail of Dashte-e Shar air base to ensure your safe arrival to Dashte-e Shar air base."

After a moment, the pilot radios back "Squadron Leader Tabari, we acknowledge your message. The President orders you to get into a protective formation around the presidential plane."

The fighter jets arrange themselves on all sides of the presidential plane and continue their escort.

[B]Inside the Plane[/b]

Inside the presidential plane, President Koroush is making rapid radio calls to all possible air force bases and some army bases too. Much to his dismay, both his air force captains and the army officers acting in the stead of their absent generals and colonels would not commit themselves to an attack on the capital due to the unknown circumstances on the ground risking escalation.

Nevertheless, President Koroush manages to convince some of them to prepare for an attack on the capital pending his arrival to Dashte-e Shar air base.

Not too long afterwards, his plane lands as expected in Dashte-shar air base. President Koroush leaps out of his seat and quickly makes his way down the stairs, followed by his ministers, only to be encountered by Colonel Jamshid and five soldiers with him, none of whom salute.

The president is unsettled by the lack of respect but nevertheless, glances at his uniform before asking "colonel, there is a coup. How many men do you have with you?"

"President Koroush and Ministers Emam and Jalayer, your government has been dissolved. I am under orders by General Fereydun to detain you and bring you to the army headquarters. I request your cooperation to make this as easy as possible for all of us." With that, Colonel Jamshid orders his men to grab President Koroush and bundle him into the humvee while the ministers are to be zip tied to a chair in the lounge and placed under guard.

With President Koroush secured and the ministers being led away, Colonel Jamshid gets in the humvee and drives to the army headquarters.

[B]President Koroush Resigns[/b]
[I]Two hours later...[/i]

President Koroush is seated at a desk, surrounded by nine other officers of the army, navy, and air force seated in a semi-circle. In the center of the semi-circle, General Fereydun, on the inside two chairs next to General Fereydun are other army generals and on the outer two chairs on both sides are one air force General and one navy admiral each.

"The armed forces have taken over Mr. Koroush. Any resistance will be irresponsible and risk plunging the country into chaos and civil war. We have prepared your resignation statement for you to sign."

President Koroush reads the statement on the desk.

"Recognising that should President Koroush continue to assert his government in the current political situation would be irresponsible, risk fracturing the army, and risk a civil war, President Koroush declares that he formally cedes his administration to the armed forces for a transitionary government to take effect to protect the rights and welfare of Dhornaper and its Citizens."

President Koroush thinks over in silence. Eventually he picks up his pen and signs it before handing it to General Fereydun.

"You will be placed under house arrest until a suitable country is found for you to live in exile" General Fereydun states before getting up to leave. He is followed by the generals and admirals a moment after. President Koroush stays in the room, holding his head in his hands for the next fifteen minutes before being escorted to his home outside Shar.[/quote]
